name: Key Contract Terms for Exterior Painting in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: What should I include in an exterior painting contract in Los Angeles County to protect myself if the job starts peeling within a few years?
mainEntity.text: What should I include in an exterior painting contract in Los Angeles County to protect myself if the job starts peeling within a few years?

acceptedAnswer.text: A vague exterior painting contract can leave Los Angeles County homeowners with little recourse if the finish peels or fails early. Ask your contractor to convert their bid into a detailed written agreement. It should list all surfaces to be painted, prep steps (washing method, scraping, sanding, patching, caulking), primers and finish paints by brand, product line, and sheen, plus the number of coats for each. Include a color schedule, referencing swatch numbers or names, and clarify if the painter will keep a record for future touch-ups. The warranty section needs more than just a number of years; it should specify what types of failure are covered (peeling, blistering, excessive cracking), what is excluded (structural movement, water intrusion from behind walls, or damage from sprinklers), and whether labor, materials, or both are included in warranty repairs. Establish how to report issues, expected response time, and whether touch-ups will match existing sheen. Also include start and estimated completion dates, payment schedule tied to milestones, and a clause that final payment is due after a joint walkthrough and punch-list completion. Having this level of detail in writing gives you leverage if problems arise and encourages the contractor to prioritize quality workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: A protective exterior painting contract should spell out surface prep steps, specific products, coat counts, color choices, and written warranty terms, including what is covered, duration, and repair process. Clear documentation makes it easier to enforce peeling or failure claims within the agreed timeframe.
